caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a horse in motion, appearing to be running. The horse is primarily colored in shades of gray, with distinct reddish-brown patches on its body, including its cheek, chest, shoulder, midsection, hindquarters, and all four legs. The horse has black hooves and a black mane depicted with angular, pointed segments that extend upwards and backwards along the neck. The tail is large, rounded, and similarly gray with darker shading along the outline. The horse’s head is shown with a single visible, large, round black eye and a small pointed ear, as well as two small brownish marks on its jaw. The legs and joints are stylized with geometric and angular forms, and the horse is drawn without additional background elements, positioned centrally on a blank, off-white background.
title: Horse
